# awscc_bedrock_retrieval_instruction (Data Source)

Data Source schema for AWS::Bedrock::RetrievalInstruction



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the resource.
- `created_at` (String) When the retrieval instruction was created. On a numbered version, when that version was created.
- `customer_encryption_key_arn` (String) The ARN of the customer managed KMS key protecting this content, when one was supplied at create.
- `description` (String) A description of the retrieval instruction. On a numbered version, the description of that version.
- `instruction` (Attributes) The reviewed content this instruction serves ? what AgenticRetrieveStream resolves while status is ACTIVE. Absent until the first create review passes. Always present on a numbered version. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--instruction))
- `last_transition_status` (String) The outcome or in-progress state of the most recent create or update. CREATING or UPDATING means the operation is still running. Independent of status. Always has a value from the create 202 onward. On a numbered version this is always CREATE_SUCCESSFUL: a version is created once, from reviewed content, and is immutable.
- `name` (String) The name of the retrieval instruction.
- `retrieval_instruction_id` (String) The identifier of the retrieval instruction.
- `status` (String) Whether the instruction can be used. Only ACTIVE is resolvable at retrieval time. Monotone: INACTIVE to ACTIVE once, never back. Numbered versions are always ACTIVE.
- `tags` (Attributes Set) An array of key-value pairs to apply to this resource. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))
- `updated_at` (String) When the retrieval instruction was last updated. Equal to createdAt on a numbered version, which is immutable.

<a id="nestedatt--instruction"></a>
### Nested Schema for `instruction`

Read-Only:

- `answer_format` (String) How the answer is structured, including how sources are cited.
- `answer_policy` (String) Whether and how to answer: how strongly an answer must be supported, and what to do with questions outside scope.
- `persona` (String) Who the assistant is: identity, tone and language.
- `retrieval_guidance` (String) How to interpret and decompose the question, and what to prioritise when searching.


<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Read-Only:

- `key` (String) The key name of the tag.
- `value` (String) The value for the tag.
